set -euo pipefail; D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-mcp-wire-broker.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf -- "$D"' EXIT; export GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -i /home/ai-core-node/.local/share/clay-local-bridge/keys/id_ed25519 -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/clay-local-bridge/keys/known_hosts'; git clone -q git@github.com:gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$D/repo"; cd "$D/repo"; git checkout -q chatgpt/omega-mcp-fallback-stack-20260912; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tools/install_omega_chatgpt_mcp_ai_core.sh'); s=p.read_text()
anchor='''  ensure_kv OMEGA_MCP_GATEWAY_OWNER gabriel\n  ensure_kv OMEGA_MCP_LOCAL_FALLBACK_ENABLED 1\n'''
replacement='''  ensure_kv OMEGA_MCP_GATEWAY_OWNER gabriel\n  ensure_kv OMEGA_MCP_DIRECT_GABRIEL_URL http://127.0.0.1:8765\n  ensure_kv OMEGA_MCP_LOCAL_FALLBACK_ENABLED 1\n'''
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('existing-env anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor,replacement,1)
anchor2='''OMEGA_MCP_GATEWAY_OWNER=gabriel\nOMEGA_MCP_LOCAL_FALLBACK_ENABLED=1\n'''
replacement2='''OMEGA_MCP_GATEWAY_OWNER=gabriel\nOMEGA_MCP_DIRECT_GABRIEL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765\nOMEGA_MCP_LOCAL_FALLBACK_ENABLED=1\n'''
if anchor2 not in s: raise SystemExit('new-env anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor2,replacement2,1)
unit='''EnvironmentFile=%h/.config/omega/omega-mcp.env\nExecStart=%h/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/run.sh\n'''
unit_new='''EnvironmentFile=%h/.config/omega/omega-mcp.env\n# Reuse the existing typed host-broker token in-memory; never copy or print it.\nEnvironmentFile=-%h/.config/frankenstein/chatgpt-client.env\nExecStart=%h/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/run.sh\n'''
if unit not in s: raise SystemExit('unit anchor missing')
s=s.replace(unit,unit_new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
bash -n tools/install_omega_chatgpt_mcp_ai_core.sh; git diff --check; git add tools/install_omega_chatgpt_mcp_ai_core.sh; git -c user.name='OMEGA ChatGPT' -c user.email='omega@local' commit -q -m 'omega: wire existing typed broker into MCP fallback'; git push -q origin HEAD:chatgpt/omega-mcp-fallback-stack-20260912; echo PUSHED=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
